description: This header file declares functions, enums, and includes related to process management within a watchdog service, including starting/stopping processes, acknowledging service start, and monitoring service states.

methods.name: startConfiguredProcessesAndWait
methods.description: Starts all configured processes and waits for one to terminate, typically called from main thread.

methods.name: getAllServiceProcessInfo
methods.description: Populates a linked list with process info for known services.

methods.name: getAllServiceNames
methods.description: Populates a linked list with the names of all known services.

methods.name: acknowledgeServiceStarted
methods.description: Locates a service by name and updates its last acknowledgment time.

methods.name: areAllServicesStarted
methods.description: Checks if all services have been started and the watchdog init is complete.

methods.name: countServicesToBeAcknowledged
methods.description: Counts services expecting startup acknowledgment but not yet acknowledged.

methods.name: countSinglePhaseServicesToBeAcknowledged
methods.description: Counts single-phase startup services pending acknowledgment.

methods.name: stopMonitoringService
methods.description: Disables restart on fail for a specified service.

methods.name: getServiceForName
methods.description: Retrieves a clone of a service definition by name; caller must free.

methods.name: operationOnAllProcesses
methods.description: Performs start/stop/restart on all known services.

methods.name: operationOnSingleProcesses
methods.description: Performs start/stop/restart on a specific service by name.

methods.name: operationOnGroupOfProcesses
methods.description: Performs start/stop/restart on services within a specified group.

methods.name: startProcess
methods.description: Launches a service process, with optional restart after crash.
